name: Freedom Arrow — 0.8 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.8: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.8.0-dev.75: DF-17 missile 2000 supply, SR-5 Fire Dragon launcher names; 0.8.0-dev.74: radar works on JRVG-1, PGZ-09, HJ-10 and AFT-10; 0.8.0-dev.73: FK-2000 guns 20 damage/s each (PGL-625 gun stats); 0.8.0-dev.72: PGZ-88 with ZTZ-59D armour, unarmed ZSD-89A with AMPV stats, ZTZ-100 front KE 750; 0.8.0-dev.71: PGL-625 gun 20 damage/s with ZBL-191 armour, WZ-8 high altitude only; 0.8.0-dev.70: WZ-8 300 points; 0.8.0-dev.69: PLZ-05 as a 2S35 Koalitsiya copy with Chinese munitions; 0.8.0-dev.68: PLARF Infantry without HJ-73D; 0.8.0-dev.67: Sea Dragons and Beijing Swords amphibious, Forward Observers VDV Razvedka icon; 0.8.0-dev.66: tank road speeds back to dev.60, ZTZ-100 4 s reload, ZBD-251 APS option; 0.8.0-dev.65: 105 mm APFSDS 550/500 on ZTL-191, VT-5, ZTQ-15; no SEAD loadouts on FH-97A and MD-22; 0.8.0-dev.64: CH-901 damage 15; 0.8.0-dev.63: DF-ZF top speed 1200 interceptability test, DF-17/ZF 250 points; 0.8.0-dev.62: DF-ZF 3x acceleration with no speed cap during the boost, DF missile glass kept in matches; 0.8.0-dev.61: tracked vehicles get +60% on roads (road = 1.6x off-road); 0.8.0-dev.60: WZ-550 name, AA gun ranges, spec moves, ZTL-191 Recon, QBZ-95/QBB-95/QBU-88 models, DZD98A 10, no stand-in flash; 0.8.0-dev.59: FK-2000 dual guns with PGL-625 gun stats; 0.8.0-dev.58: purchased FK-2000 model; 0.8.0-dev.57: PGL-625 as a Pantsir, PGZ-09 Pantsir guns, PHL-16 rockets 48 dmg, PHL-191 Fire Dragon names, PGZ-88 80, JRVG-1 to PLAN SOF with longer range, HQ-7B to PLAAF, HQ-17A also Motorized, HQ-6A to Motorized; 0.8.0-dev.56: PLA infantry cards from Osama's six images (SF High Tech, SF CQC, SF Jungle for PLAGF Armored, Airborne, Marines, Motorized); 0.8.0-dev.55: J-5 to J-8 cannons, Z-8L King Stallion and WZ-7 Global Hawk stat copies, ZBD-251 HJ-16, Z-10K Longbow optics, DF-15 tyres/missile/glass, crew hidden on Lynx, SR-5 and HMV3; 0.8.0-dev.54: DF-31A 10-minute rearm and 30000 supply; 0.8.0-dev.53: seller-texture reworks (DF-15, PHL-03, CSK-181, PCL-181, QN-506, ZBD-04, PGL-625, KQ-200), SR-5 without its driver; 0.8.0-dev.52: DF-ZF flies a ballistic arc with double acceleration; 0.8.0-dev.51: vanilla glass on 13 Chinese models, more metal on HQ-6A and Z-11WB; 0.8.0-dev.50: DF-ZF no longer hits its own launcher, DF-31A normal aim time and 500 m blast; 0.8.0-dev.49: roster removals, FH-97A strike packages without air-to-air, J-5/6/7/8 heavy strike and no ECM, model fixes (Lynx riders, Z-10, Z-8L, ZSD-89A, PLZ-07, unrigged camo tanks); 0.8.0-dev.48: PHL-191 Ballistic with 2x ATACMS or 2x PrSM at 225; 0.8.0-dev.47: seller woodland digital ZTQ-15/ZTZ-99/ZBL-191/ZTZ-100, PGZ-09 guns, HQ-17 radars, ZTL-191 turret, turretless ZSL-92; 0.8.0-dev.46: ABZ-13 as the BLAAM, HE ATGMs 60 penetration; 0.8.0-dev.45: HJ-10 weapon icon on the AFT-10 and ZBD-251; 0.8.0-dev.44: HQ-6A in the seller Camouflage set; 0.8.0-dev.43: seller camo reconnected on DF-15, PCL-181 and ZSD-89A; 0.8.0-dev.42: seller-provided textures on all purchased models (desert recolours and generated digital camo removed); 0.8.0-dev.41: PLA infantry card portraits (Conscripts, Motorized/Armored, Airborne, Marines and Sea Dragons, Snipers); 0.8.0-dev.40: QN-506 in woodland digital, ZBL-08 on the ZBL-09 model; 0.8.0-dev.39: 17 purchased models from Osama's cart (DF-15, DF-17, HQ-6A, HQ-11, PHL-03, PHL-16, PHL-191 Ballistic, PCL-181, AFT-09, CTL-181, CSK-181, QN-506, ZBD-251, ZSD-89, ZSD-89A, ZSL-92, ZTZ-59D); 0.8.0-dev.38: PLZ-05 gun and HQ-17 radars fixed, HQ-17 at wheeled speed, woodland digital ZBD-04 and ZTZ-100, ZTZ-96A/96B models swapped; 0.8.0-dev.37: woodland digital ZTZ-99, ZTZ-99A, ZTZ-96 and ZTZ-96B, desert digital ZTQ-15 Recon; 0.8.0-dev.36: VT-5 and VT-5 Recon for Motorized (VT-5 also PLAN Navy/SOF) with APS, ZTZ-96A front and SRAT II sides; ZTQ-15 pair in PLAGF Armored (woodland digital); 0.8.0-dev.35: ZTQ-62-I removed, new ZTZ-59D1 recon tank (PLARF), ZFB-05 on the BPM-97 model, ZTQ-15 in digital camo (desert Motorized, woodland Recon), US voice lines at 70% (FA Music 1.5.2); 0.8.0-dev.34: US voice lines 6 dB quieter (FA Music 1.5.1); 0.8.0-dev.33: Shawn's models (HQ-17/17A, J-20S, PLZ-05, ZTZ-96/96A, ZTL-191, ZBL-09, Z-21, Type 052D, PGL-625, PGZ-09); FBX animation offsets baked out; 0.8.0-dev.32: purchased models fixed (guns on PLL-09, PLZ-45A4, PLZ-83, PLZ-89; clear glass; Jiutian faces forward); 0.8.0-dev.31: smoother ZSL-92 surface; 0.8.0-dev.30: MD-22 Heavy strike, Godswords 100, Spike and GAM-102LR 140 penetration; 0.8.0-dev.29: 22 purchased ShuyangXi models (DF-21, DF-31A, PLZ/PCL/PLL artillery, HQ-12, PGZ-88, PTL-02, J-5/6/7, KJ-500, KQ-200, Y-8, Jiutian, WZ-7, Z-8L); 0.8.0-dev.28: QN-202 18 damage at half rate; 0.8.0-dev.27: QLU-11 almost no dispersion; 0.8.0-dev.26: QN-202 damage 9; 0.8.0-dev.25: CTL-181 missile without laser guidance; 0.8.0-dev.24: Godswords 80, QLU-11 at the full XM25 rate; 0.8.0-dev.23: darker ZSL-92 with a stronger metallic layer; 0.8.0-dev.22: conscript rifles another 30% slower, WZ-8 as an RQ-170 with MiG-31 flight; 0.8.0-dev.21: DPS-per-point price and kit pass, CH-901 rework with Blood Wolves laser, QLU-11 and QTS-11 grenade launcher tuned as XM25; 0.8.0-dev.20: launcher ammo parity, non-transports lose seats; 0.8.0-dev.19: ZSL-92 retexture pilot (woodland digital); 0.8.0-dev.18: FAModels 0.3.17 infantry body fix; ZBL-191 with HJ-16 (1500 m), APS and SRAT II armour (105); 0.8.0-dev.16: transport cleanup (no logistics vehicles, Shaanxi Troop Truck or Z-20T as squad transports, CSK-131 merged, CSK-181 in Airborne/Navy/Motorized, Chinese Lynx weapons); 0.8.0-dev.14: HJ-10 is a semi-active Hellfire that fires at spotted enemies without its own line of sight (runtime hook); CH-901 is a CTL-181-style munition. Includes the dev.8 aircraft batch and CTL-181 NLOS (8 damage, 1800 m). Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.5.
